units.title: Work safety in a livestock farm environment

learning_outcomes.description: Work safety in a livestock farm environment

performance_criteria.description: Explain safe work practices as obtained along the livestock production value chain
Identify safety signs and symbols on livestock farms
Identify the safety signs and symbols in livestock facilities
Demonstrate safe work practices and instructions on livestock farms
Operate in accordance with health and safety practices

learning_outcomes.description: Comply with safety standards on livestock Farm.

performance_criteria.description: Identify work environment hazards
State types of hazards and risks associated with livestock farms and processing facilities
State safety standards on livestock farms and processing facilities
Use safety tools, materials and equipment in livestock processing facilities

learning_outcomes.description: Apply personal protective equipment (PPE) in livestock processing facilities

performance_criteria.description: Identify the types of PPEs required for livestock processing plants
Select appropriate PPE for livestock processing plants
Demonstrate the use of PPE
Maintain PPEs before or after use

learning_outcomes.description: Respond to accidents/injury in livestock processing plants

performance_criteria.description: Locate first aid facility
Use basic dressing materials for first aid
Respond to supervisor`s given instructions
Report incidences of accident/injury to the appropriate supervisor

learning_outcomes.description: Apply safe work habit and clean work environment in livestock processing plants

performance_criteria.description: Use safe access and exit routes in the work environment
Identify appropriate working tools, materials and equipment
Use tools and equipment safely in accordance with the supervisors instructions
Return all tools, equipment and unused materials for appropriate storage
Carry out general housekeeping of work environment
Dispose all wastes appropriately to designated waste facilities

learning_outcomes.description: Comply with standards of lifting, loading/offloading and stacking of materials in livestock processing facilities

performance_criteria.description: Identify lifting and stacking techniques
Demonstrate lifting techniques in loading and offloading of materials without assistance
Demonstrate correct lifting and loading techniques with mechanical assistance
Stack materials correctly

units.title: Effective communication in livestock Farm Environment

learning_outcomes.description: Apply the use of a non-complex communication system in a work environment

performance_criteria.description: Use verbal means to pass on necessary information
Use non-verbal means to convey necessary information e.g.  body language,  signs
Interpret symbols and signs appropriately

learning_outcomes.description: Source for information on a livestock work environment

performance_criteria.description: Identify the source of information in the work environment
Relate effectively with the source of information
Use the different information flow systems in a work environment
Use information gathered to avoid challenges in a work situation
Report findings appropriately in accordance with laid down procedures in the work environment i.e.  Cards,  Flip Chart
Use simple communication gadget like  mobile phones and  table phones

learning_outcomes.description: Apply various means of communication in a livestock work environment

performance_criteria.description: Locate the various communication equipment in the work environment Use effectively the various communication equipment in a work environment
Pass information effectively to the right personnel
Obey instructions in line with ethics of the work environment

learning_outcomes.description: Know Positive working relationship with colleagues

performance_criteria.description: Identify the need for developing positive working relationship with colleagues
Recognize the importance of relating with other people in a way that makes them feel valued and respected
Assist team members when required.
Report to the appropriate personnel when request for assistance fall outside area of responsibility.
Communicate information to colleagues about individual work that may affect team work.

learning_outcomes.description: Take responsibility within the team

performance_criteria.description: Recognize own role and responsibilities within a team
Perform individual tasks in line with the team’s rules and regulations.
Participate effectively in teamwork.

learning_outcomes.description: Compliance with policy of organisation

performance_criteria.description: Explain organizational code of conduct
Work in line with organizational standard
Use organizational code of practice
Adhere strictly to instructions given by the Management

units.title: Routine management practices in ruminant production

learning_outcomes.description: Carryout routine management practice in ruminant production

performance_criteria.description: Carry out deworming of all animals except the pregnant animals on the farm
Carry out hoof trimming, dehorning, nose ring application on all animals with an over grown hooves on the farm
Carry out dipping/spraying against ecto- parasite using the appropriate agents
Carry out daily cleaning routine management practices using, brooms, shovels etc.

learning_outcomes.description: Use the basic equipment to carry out management practices in ruminant production

performance_criteria.description: Identify tools and equipment in management practice in ruminant production (drenching gun, hoof trimmer, etc.)
Use the drenching gun or syringe to carry out deworming.
Use the hoof trimmer to carry out the hoof trimming of all animals with over grown hooves
Use polling ring or caustic soda to dehorn
Use the dipping pit or Knapsack sprayer against ecto-parasite on all animals on the farm

learning_outcomes.description: Maintain equipment handling before and after usage

performance_criteria.description: Wash deworming equipment after use
Disinfect equipment after use.
Ensure proper handling and safe keeping of all equipment after use.
Disinfect and rest the house after disease outbreak

units.title: Management of dry, pregnant and lactating animals

learning_outcomes.description: Carryout the management of the open stage of ruminant animals

performance_criteria.description: Identify the dry/open stage of ruminant animals
Carryout flushing exercise of livestock
Carryout mating of the animals

learning_outcomes.description: Carryout the management of pregnant ruminant animals

performance_criteria.description: Identify the pregnant stage of ruminant animals
Identify the management practice of pregnant stage of ruminant
Carryout proper feeding of the pregnant animal.
Carryout steaming of ruminant animals during late pregnancy.

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the management of lactating ruminant animals and their young ones

performance_criteria.description: Identify the lactating stage of ruminant animals
Explain the importance of management practices of the lactating animals and their young ones
Recognize the importance of additional ration to the lactating animals based on the number and age of their young ones

units.title: Selection criteria for breeding in ruminants

learning_outcomes.description: Carryout different selection methods in ruminant production

performance_criteria.description: Carry out different methods of selection naturally
Carry out different methods of selection artificially.
Carryout selection for ruminant breeding (rump angle, well developed testicles, teats etc)
Select traits for fattening
Select trait for milk (dairy)

learning_outcomes.description: Understand different breeding methods

performance_criteria.description: Carryout out breeding
Bring the animals together for natural mating
Assist in artificial insemination

learning_outcomes.description: monitor and carryout management of a pregnant ruminant

performance_criteria.description: Monitor animals for signs of heat
Administer proper diet of the ruminant
Assist the Dams during Calving, Lambing or Kidding.

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate the basic handling of milk

performance_criteria.description: Identify milking equipment
Carryout milking
Pasteurize the Milk
Store the milk after Pasteurization appropriately

learning_outcomes.description: Demonstrate basic handling of meat

performance_criteria.description: Identify the equipment used in meat handling
Slaughter the animal, bleed, eviscerate and wash the carcass etc
Cut the carcass into different parts
Store the meat appropriately

learning_outcomes.description: Carry out marketing of Milk and Meat products

performance_criteria.description: Identify market sources and outlets for ruminant products
Process and package the meat product for sale (kilishi, dambu)
Process and package the milk products (yoghurt) for sales
Carryout marketing of the products

units.title: Feed production and utilization in ruminants

learning_outcomes.description: Understand ruminants’ nutrition

performance_criteria.description: Describe the general functions of feed to ruminant animals
Identify the major classes of nutrient needed by ruminant animals
Select feed ingredients for energy sources of feed for ruminant animals e.g.:  Maize,  wheat, and  grass
Select both plant and animal sources of protein e.g.:  Soy-beans,  groundnut  fish meal,  blood meal etc.
Select the sources of fat in ruminant animals e.g:  palm oil,  palm kernel etc.
Select the mineral sources of feed in ruminant animals
Identify the vitamin sources of feed in ruminant animals

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the functions of different classes of feed in ruminant animals

performance_criteria.description: Describe the function of carbohydrates
Identify the meaning of fiber and its role in the ruminant animals
Identify the function of protein in ruminant animals
Identify the function of fat and oil (Lipids)
Identify the function of vitamins
Explain the function of water and estimate the water requirement of ruminant animals in the tropics

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the techniques for formulating feeds for ruminant animals

performance_criteria.description: Identify the components of feed mill
Assemble the components of feed mill
Collect different ingredients to the production floor
Carry out hay and silage making
Measure, package and store the finish feed

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the diseases of the ruminant animal

performance_criteria.description: Explain the different types of disease-causing pathogens of ruminant animals
Identify the diseases caused by bacteria in ruminant animals
Identify the diseases caused by fungi in ruminant animals
Identify the diseases caused by viruses in ruminant animals
Identify the diseases caused by protozoa in ruminant animals
Explain the effect of unbalanced diet and how it causes nutritional disease
Describe the parasitic diseases of ruminant animals

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the state of an unhealthy animal

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different signs of diseases in ruminant animals
Identify the predisposing factors to disease in ruminant animals
Isolate and quarantine the unhealthy ruminants

learning_outcomes.description: Understand the basic principles of treatment of diseases including drugs administration

performance_criteria.description: Identify the different routes of drugs administration
Administer common drugs used in treating different types of diseases (coccidiostat, dewormers etc).
Administer drugs as directed using syringe and needle to inject ruminant animals ( for animal health technologist)
